about: A press on a question in the message box is the box's, not the world's under it. The skill window goes to its list view, which leaves the right of the message box over open ground; a skill level is made pending and Apply asks. A click on the question's Cancel closes it (the level stays pending) and asks no walk: before, `on_ui` kept a window list of its own that had missed this question, so the press also walked the character to the cell under the button. Ends a Novice with no skill points.
